rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for an opera as a staged musical drama.

example.english: We’re going to see an opera tonight.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 tai2 go1 kek6

rows.note: Use this for traditional Chinese opera rather than opera in the general Western or international sense.

example.english: My grandma loves watching Chinese opera and goes whenever there is a festival.
example.traditional: 我阿婆最鍾意睇戲曲，逢年過節都去睇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 po4 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tai2 hei3 kuk1 fung4 nin4 gwo3 zit3 dou1 heoi3 tai2

rows.note: Use this for the building or venue where operas are performed.

example.english: This opera house is beautiful, and opera is performed here all the time.
example.traditional: 呢座歌劇院好靚，成日都有歌劇喺度上演。
example.jyutping: nei1 zo6 go1 kek6 jyun2 hou2 leng3 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 go1 kek6 hai2 dou6 soeng5 jin2
